top.line: Silvio Switha's portfolio site, made in under an hour, with his music video first and five designs.

in-short.line: A portfolio; the film first; under an hour; agents three ways; for clients; nothing made up.

who.line: AI entrepreneur, musician and producer who built UNIVERSO, Gravity, X-Ray and Know the Reach at Web Summit.
who.para: Looking for projects, with his permission for the site.

timeline.line: HTTPS in 55 seconds, a first version in five minutes, five designs from 21:29 to 21:34, then a handover.
timeline.para: The same flow as Yiheng Wang's site.

film.line: Know the Reach plays in the first screen of every design, with its credits and its making as a funnel.

designs.line: Premiere, Universe, The Studio, The Proposal and On Tour: the same facts, five ways.

agents.line: His 17 agents as a solar system in six rings, bars by group, and a mixing desk.

studio.line: The Studio draws the film's making as a DAW session; On Tour is a red and black gig poster.

hire.line: Real, linked work, and how to hire him in each design's voice, with services to confirm.
hire.para: Plus a page for your AI.

him.line: Nothing invented: his film, his universe, sourced numbers, teammates cropped out, gaps marked.

two.line: Two sites in one evening from the same method look nothing alike, because the evidence differs.

limits.line: A first version he approves; timings from status and commits; services to confirm; screenshots of one evening.

sources.line: The live site, its repository and the factory request, and earlier articles.
